recheck_rule: recheck_horizon_days is measured against evidence_as_of_utc, NEVER against last_rechecked_utc. Re-reading a file that has not changed is not a recheck and must not reset the clock -- that is precisely how "MEASURED: both 404 as of 2026-09-08" survived snap_counts publishing two days later. last_rechecked_utc records only that a person or tool looked; evidence_as_of_utc records the newest instant in what they saw.
recheck_horizon_note: The horizons are ATTENTION thresholds, not claims about truth. A claim does not become false by ageing. Each one is set to the shortest interval over which the underlying fact could plausibly have changed, and carries its reason in recheck_horizon_basis.
assignment_rule: recheck_executable_here=false means the recheck needs bytes from outside this checkout. It is then ASSIGNED, with an outbox entry named in recheck_assignment -- never left standing as a fact.
